# .github/ — GitHub Configuration

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `FUNDING.yml` | Sponsor button — Buy Me a Coffee + GitHub Sponsors |
| `dependabot.yml` | Monthly npm + GitHub Actions updates. Two groups per ecosystem: `minor-patch` (one PR) and `major` (isolated). **No `ignore:` rules** — Dependabot applies them to security updates too, which would silence a CVE only patched in a major |
| `workflows/ci.yml` | Push / PR to `main` — `npm ci` → lint → typecheck → tests at 100% coverage → build, on Node.js 20 and 22 |
| `workflows/security.yml` | Monthly cron + manual dispatch — Semgrep, Trivy, Gitleaks and SonarQube. The first three upload SARIF to Code scanning; SonarQube skips cleanly without `SONAR_TOKEN` / `SONAR_HOST_URL` |
| `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | PR template with checklist (gates, i18n, theming, a11y touch targets, aria-labels, heading hierarchy, SEO metadata, robots directives, sitemap, security) |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md` | Bug report template (env, steps, screenshots) |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md` | Feature request template (use case, solution, alternatives) |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/security_vulnerability.md` | Security report template (responsible disclosure) |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` | Issue template chooser config (disables blank issues, adds contact links) |

There is deliberately **no `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`**. GitHub resolves
`CONTRIBUTING.md` from `.github/`, the repository root and `docs/`, in that
order, so [`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) is already linked
from the issue and pull-request UI. Keeping a second short copy here would be a
second source of truth for the same rules, and it had already drifted (stale
test counts, an outdated rule list) before it was removed.

Every action referenced in a workflow is **pinned to a full commit SHA** with the
tag in a trailing comment. A mutable tag can be re-pointed by whoever controls
the action repository, which makes it an unreviewed code-execution channel.

## Root Community Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` | Contributor Covenant v2.1 |
| `SECURITY.md` | Security policy, reporting process, response timeline (the cryptographic architecture lives in `docs/SECURITY.md`) |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Version history following Keep a Changelog format |
| `LICENSE` | MIT License |
| `.gitleaks.toml` | Gitleaks configuration — inherits every default rule, one narrowly scoped and documented allowlist for i18n keys in `PrivacyContent.tsx` |
